notes: לִפְנֵי → 'to meet' split under rule 30's own example (to on אֶל, meet on פָּנֶה); מִלִּפְנֵי → 'from before' splits מִן from the fused לִפְנֵי since the ASV spends a word on each.

'for this thing': the for is read as the causal בְּ's preposition governing the demonstrative, leaving the clause-initial waw unrepresented; the competing rule-14 allocation (for to the waw, בְּ unrepresented) remains defensible and is named in the unit note.

Interrogative הֲ takes the fronted 'Shouldest' (rule 17); the three לְ prepositions on the wicked, the infinitive and the participle are each unrepresented under rules 40/52 because the ASV writes bare objects and no to.
